// CASE plain_weak_self expect=pass
final class A {
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task { [weak self] in
          await self?.work(item)
        })
    }
  }
}

// CASE prio_weak_self expect=pass
final class A2 {
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task(priority: .utility) { [weak self] in
          await self?.work(item)
        })
    }
  }
}

// CASE prio_weak_self_bare_stmt expect=pass
final class A3 {
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      Task(priority: .utility) { [weak self] in
        await self?.work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE prio_capture_value expect=pass
func f1(_ items: [Int], store: Store) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .utility) { [store] in
        await store.save(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE plain_capture_value expect=pass
func f1b(_ items: [Int], store: Store) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task { [store] in
        await store.save(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE prio_mainactor_in expect=pass
func f2(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .utility) { @MainActor in
        await ui.update(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE generic_prio expect=pass
func f3(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task<Void, Never>(priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE generic_plain expect=pass
func f3b(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task<Void, Never> {
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE let_prio expect=pass
func f4(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}

// CASE let_plain expect=pass
func f4b(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}

// CASE var_prio expect=pass
func f4c(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    var task = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
    task = Task {}
  }
}

// CASE let_detached_prio expect=pass
func f4d(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}

// CASE let_prio_typed expect=pass
func f4e(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task: Task<Void, Never> = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}

// CASE assign_prio expect=pass
func f4f(_ items: [Int]) {
  var task: Task<Void, Never>?
  for item in items {
    task = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
  }
  _ = task
}

// CASE return_in_map expect=pass
func f5(_ items: [Int]) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var out: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    out += [Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }]
  }
  return out
}

// CASE prio_two_statements expect=pass
func f6(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
        await log(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE prio_closure_param expect=pass
func f7(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .utility) { () async -> Void in
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}
